title: Erectile dysfunction treatment
what: The doctor finds out why erections have become weaker and chooses treatment. It may be pills, lifestyle changes, procedures, or injections.
why: If your erection has not been firm enough for sex for several months in a row.
duration: the visit usually takes 20 to 40 minutes; treatment is set over a few visits
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially for the heart and blood pressure
Heart disease, diabetes, high blood pressure
If you smoke, and how often you drink alcohol
If you have already tried any remedies

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Your doctor may order blood tests for sugar, cholesterol, and hormones, and sometimes a blood vessel ultrasound.

prepare.title: Talking
prepare.text: Think in advance: when it started, and if you have morning erections. This will help your doctor.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not start erection pills on your own. Some are dangerous with heart medicines.

bring: Past test results, if you have them
steps: The doctor asks about your symptoms, health, and medicines
Your blood pressure is checked, sometimes your weight
The doctor explains treatment options and chooses the right one
feel: The conversation may feel awkward. It is a routine topic for a doctor
after: Start treatment only as your doctor said
Exercise, not smoking, and less alcohol help
Come back for a follow-up to check the result
red_flags: An erection lasting more than 4 hours and painful: call emergency services
Chest pain after taking an erection medicine: call emergency services

faq.a: In most cases, yes. Your doctor will choose a method for your cause and health.

faq.q: Can I take erection pills without a doctor?
faq.a: Better not. Some heart medicines are dangerous with them. Your doctor will say what suits you.

reminders.text: Erectile dysfunction visit tomorrow. Make a list of your medicines, and think about when the problem started.
